Name: Totoro Cannoli - Secret Woods
Author: sashaldystauns
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/5ZdBQv6.png[/img]
Replace the Secret Woods statue with a standing Totoro holding his iconic umbrella. Enjoy Totoro’s whimsical presence as you explore the Secret Woods.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HudgTlZ.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Toggle Mod: Easily enable or disable the mod with a simple switch.
[*]Umbrella Color: Change Totoro’s umbrella color during winter to match your seasonal preferences (Black or Blue).
[*]Persistent Smile: Keep Totoro’s smile after feeding him, adding an extra touch of joy to your interactions.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q4o3aNa.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Make sure you've got the latest SMAPI﻿ and Content Patcher﻿﻿﻿.
[*]While not required, the Generic Mod Config Menu﻿ is highly recommended (you can make changes in-game).
[*]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder (you can choose only one of two versions). 
[*]Launch the game with this mod once to generate a config file if you prefer to manually adjust the configs.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DpQRWUi.png[/img]
✔ Any custom map mods or mods that expand the map. (e.g., [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Reimagined 3[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3679]Capitalist Dream Farm[/url])

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IRcHegE.png[/img]
✘ Any mods that change the appearance of Mr. Cannoli.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gm0xiBI.png[/img]
✔ If any problem happens to you, just let me know in the comments, and I'll make sure to help you out. ^^

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F32EG1g.png[/img]
1.0.0 - Initial release of the mod.
[list]
[/list][quote]﻿If you enjoy this mod, please kindly consider giving it an endorsement. It will mean a lot to me <3[/quote][quote]﻿Credits: Special thanks to Xiaoyang for the inspiration.
